changelog: Aura AI v2.1.1 Voice Screen Polish, Native Screen Share & Language Picker
Voice Screen Greeting & Polish: Responsive greeting title with user name interpolation and live status states (Listening, Thinking, Speaking)
Instant Voice Start: Tapping 'Tap to Start' directly initiates voice conversation without setup detours
Voice Spoken Language Picker: Tapping the Language button opens a quick modal with Auto Detect, English, Hindi, and multi-language support
Hardware Screen Share Integration: Full MediaProjection screen sharing based on Playlist_part7 with active sharing indicator and toggle
Drawer Voice Setting Action: Added 'Voice Setting' entry in the sidebar More section for quick access to speech settings
